I found the cause of the reload error and closed three gaps, all committed on `michael/dev`. I didn't reproduce the error, so the cause is the most likely fit rather than proven. The sessions page loads clean now, but the new hook, the reload pre-flight and the screenshot gate haven't been run end to end.

**Cause.** The sessions-grid agent edited the sessions-page modules straight in the main tree with no reload hold (commits `a3275bd04` and `31ef0c85d`). Each file it wrote reloaded your open tab, so one reload landed between two files of the same batch and loaded a half-written page. `merge.
